context:
Decision gate (owner): approved 2026-11-19 by Joe Harris (choice dialog) for an upstream offer to tobymao/sqlglot.

Verification rubric: (1) the reduced change applies to current upstream main and stands alone, without the fork patches it stacks on; (2) its dialect tests pass, with execution checked on real SQLite; (3) the fork's downstream contract tests pass after the patches.json edit.

Guardrails: the offered change is the fork patch reduced to upstream-only behaviour with no benchbox package references; one change per PR; the patch stays carried in patches.json until upstream merges and a refresh retires it with equivalence evidence.

Upstream rules (tobymao/sqlglot AGENTS.md): Conventional Commits title ending with [CLAUDE]; minimal scope; tests in tests/dialects.

2026-11-19: offered as https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9269, fork commit 1d53fac8 (branch upstream/sqlite-set-operation-operands): one-token change in Generator.setop_sql. Verified: rows match DuckDB for 7 EXCEPT/INTERSECT/UNION and ORDER BY/LIMIT shapes on sqlite3; full upstream suite with pandas passes on branch and base (1753 vs 1752 tests). tobymao/sqlglot now accepts pull requests only from collaborators (repo setting pull_request_creation_policy=collaborators_only, observed 2026-11-19; createPullRequest refused for joeharris76), so with the owner's approval (choice dialog, 2026-11-19) the offer was filed as an issue linking the ready fork commit. Next: when upstream fixes the issue (their own commit or ours), a refresh retires the fork patch with equivalence evidence; until then the patch stays carried.

2026-11-21: upstream fixed #9269 in tobymao/sqlglot#9285 (0fc1041b), its own version. Retired through downstream/staged/sqlite-set-operation-operands.retire.json in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot#134; the patch becomes upstreamed at the first refresh onto a tag containing 0fc1041b.
description: SQLite rejects a parenthesised operand of UNION, INTERSECT and EXCEPT; the fork writes such operands as SELECT * FROM (...). No BenchBox-specific behaviour. In the fork it stacks on declined patches, so the offer needs a standalone version against upstream main. Each carried SQLite patch upstream merges reduces near-daily drift in sqlglot/generators/sqlite.py.
